---
title: "Donor Express Offers"
output: html_document
date: "2024-11-16"
---

```{r}
#Loading packages
pacman::p_load(readxl, tidyverse, janitor)
```

```{r}
#Import Agency Express Data
amx_offer_header <- read_excel("Choice Data.xlsx", sheet = "AMX_OFFER_HEADER", col_types = "text")
```

```{r}
# Data cleaning
amx_offer_header <- amx_offer_header|>
  clean_names()|>
  mutate(offerdate = mdy(offerdate)) |>
  rename(offer_date = offerdate)|>
  filter(status %in% c("CANCELLED", "RECEIPTED", "TURNEDDOWN"))
```

```{r}
# Cities in Georgia with the most Donor Express offers
amx_offer_header |>
  group_by(wcontactcity)|>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")|>
  arrange(desc(count))
```

```{r}
# Daily offer
daily_offer <- amx_offer_header |>
  select(offer_date, status)
```

```{r}
# Daily offer visualization
daily_offer|>
  filter(year(offer_date) == 2024,
         month(offer_date) == 5)|>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(
    aes(x = offer_date, fill = status)) +
  labs(title = "Daily Count of Doner Express Offers",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Status")
```

```{r}
#What happened that day???
amx_offer_header|>
  filter(offer_date == mdy("05022024"))
```

```{r}
# Daily offer count by status
full_dates <- tibble(offer_date = seq(min(daily_offer$offer_date), 
                                      max(daily_offer$offer_date), by = "day"))
daily_offer_count <- daily_offer |>
  group_by(offer_date, status) |>
  summarise(count = n(),.groups = "drop")|>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = count)|>
  right_join(full_dates, by = "offer_date")|>
  arrange(offer_date)|>
  clean_names()|>
  rename(turned_down = turneddown)

daily_offer_count
```

```{r}
# Weekly offer
weekly_offer <- daily_offer |>
  mutate(offer_week = floor_date(offer_date, "week")) |>
  select(offer_week, status)
```

```{r}
#Weekly offer visualization
weekly_offer|>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = offer_week, fill = status)) +
  labs(title = "Weekly Count of Doner Express Offers",
       x = "Week (Start Date)",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Status")
```

```{r}
# Weekly offer count by status
full_weeks <- tibble(offer_week = seq(min(weekly_offer$offer_week), 
                                      max(weekly_offer$offer_week), by = "week"))


weekly_offer_count <- weekly_offer |>
  group_by(offer_week, status) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = count)|>
  right_join(full_weeks, by = "offer_week")|>
  arrange(offer_week)|>
  clean_names()|>
  rename(turned_down = turneddown)

weekly_offer_count
```

```{r}
#Import Data on Georgia Natural Disasters
events_GA <- read_csv("events-GA-2014-2024.csv", skip = 2)
```

```{r}
# Data cleaning
disaster <- events_GA |>
  
  # Variables
  clean_names()|>
  mutate(cost = as.numeric(unadjusted_cost),
         death = as.numeric(deaths),
         begin_date = ymd(begin_date),
         end_date = ymd(end_date))|>
 
   # Structure
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(date = list(seq(begin_date, end_date, by = "day"))) |>
  unnest_longer(date)|>
  
  # Filter/select
  filter(!str_detect(disaster, "Drought|Wildfire"))|>
  select(date, disaster, cost, death)
```

```{r}
# Joining `daily_offer_count` and `disaster`
disaster_on_offer <- left_join(
  daily_offer_count|>
    rename(date = offer_date),
  disaster,
  by = "date")
```

```{r}
# Creating weekly disaster
weekly_disaster <- disaster|>
  mutate(week = floor_date(date, "week"))|>
  group_by(week, disaster)|>
  summarise(cost = first(na.omit(cost)),
            death = first(na.omit(death)),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
# Joining `weekly_offer_count` and `weekly_disaster`
weekly_disaster_on_offer <- left_join(
  weekly_offer_count|>
    rename(week = offer_week),
  weekly_disaster,
  by = "week")
```

```{r}
weekly_disaster_on_offer|>
  mutate(cost = if_else(is.na(disaster) & is.na(cost), 0, cost))|>
  filter(week >= mdy("01012018") & week <= mdy("12312018")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = receipted, color = "Weekly Receipted Offer Count")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = log(cost), color = "Estimated Cost of Natural Disaster ($, log)")) +
  
  labs(title = "Natural Disaster and Doner Express Weekly Receipted Offers",
       x = "Week",
       y = "Value",
       color = NULL ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
weekly_disaster_on_offer|>
  mutate(cost = if_else(is.na(disaster) & is.na(cost), 0, 1))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = cost, y = receipted, color = disaster))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(aes(color = NULL), method = "lm")+
  ylim(0,150)+
  labs(title = "Natural Disaster's Effect on Doner Express Weekly Receipted Offers",
       x = "Natural Disaster Occurrence (0 = None, 1 = Yes)",
       y = "Weekly Receipted Offers Count",
       color = NULL )
```
